reasons: Section 4.4 is correctly identified as the only audit right running against our party (Corio, the customer/licensee), and the cited text supports the compliant classification.

Material terms meet or exceed the preferred position: frequency capped at once per calendar year, inspection by an independent CPA reasonably acceptable to Corio, Commerce One bears all audit costs unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and review is limited to books and records with no system-access language.

The only shortfall — 'reasonable notice' instead of a fixed 30/15-day written notice period (and no express confidentiality undertaking for the auditor) — is properly treated as a minor sub-element noted in the rationale rather than a deviation; the clause is neither unlimited nor unannounced.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed, and the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraph.
